command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue';[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$j='D:/Academic/Projects/sar20m1/SAR20/runs/control'
$r=@{task=[string](Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName SAR20_MatlabControl).State;utc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')}
foreach($n in @('status.json','physics_result.json')){$f=Join-Path $j $n;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $f){$r[$n]=Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $f|ConvertFrom-Json}}
$r['matlab']=@(Get-Process MATLAB -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select-Object Id,CPU,WorkingSet64,MainWindowTitle)
$r['log_tail']=Get-Content -Tail 8 -Encoding UTF8 (Join-Path $j 'controller.log')
$r|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress
scope: Stop only abandoned SAR20 read-only JSON polling process; MATLAB untouched
